jobs.title: Development Director
jobs.description:
Timbers Company is seeking an experienced Development Director
to lead luxury real estate projects from concept through completion. In this role, you’ll shape high‑end destinations, guide cross‑functional teams, and influence the creation of iconic boutique hotels, residence clubs, and resort communities.

What You’ll Do

Lead full‑cycle development: site selection, due diligence, land assemblage, acquisition, feasibility analysis, site planning, entitlements, and permitting.
Oversee professional services: secure bids, negotiate contracts, and manage architects, engineers, and consultants.
Support financial modeling and prepare pro forma development and operating budgets.
Manage proposals, bids, and solicitation materials.
Conduct site visits, market research, and due diligence.
Prepare debt and equity financing applications and closing documentation.
Coordinate construction administration and document flow.
Prepare reports and presentations for leadership, investors, and government partners.
Collaborate with property management and sales teams during development and transition phases.
Support business development, staff training, and recruitment.
Travel as required (40%-50%)

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree required (preferred: real estate, urban planning, architecture, business, finance).
7+ years of progressive real estate development experience; ground‑up experience strongly preferred.
Strong analytical and financial skills.
Working knowledge of land use, zoning, and entitlement processes.
Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
Highly organized, self‑directed, and solutions‑oriented.
Ability to manage multiple complex projects.
Based full‑time in Winter Park, FL.

About Timbers Company

Timbers Company develops and operates boutique hotels, residence clubs, and luxury resort communities in some of the world’s most desirable destinations. We create authentic, memorable experiences rooted in world‑class hospitality and a deep sense of place.

Our Core Values

Be Authentic
Practice Humility
Cultivate Teamwork
Value Time
Be Trustworthy

Our Core Values guide how we work, how we collaborate, and how we show up for each other.

Benefits That Support You

Childcare reimbursement
Trip of a Lifetime program
Education Assistance Program
Wellness Reimbursement Program
Learning & development opportunities
Competitive pay
Volunteer time
Paid maternity/paternity leave
Team‑building events
401(k)
Vacation & personal days
Holiday pay
Health, dental, and vision insurance
LTD/STD
Life insurance

This job description is not all inclusive. Timbers Company reserves the right to amend this job description at any time.
